Title: Hydroponic Nutrient Solution: pH, EC, Mixing & Changing
Description: Run a hydroponic nutrient solution at pH 5.5–6.5 and EC 1.2–1.8 for greens or 2.0–3.0 for fruiting crops. Check daily; replace every 2–4 weeks. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic nutrients solution, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic nutrients
